description: Checks MCP servers, skills or plugins found elsewhere (web search, a README, a blog, an installed list) before they are installed or recommended: made by the product's maker or not, maintained (last code change, archived, deprecated), adopted (stars), whether a remote server answers right now and where data goes. Returns a verdict (ok / caution / avoid; ok = maintained and in use, not a quality or security review), the new name for renamed tools and better-adopted alternatives. A repo holding several skills or plugins is answered as one collection with its count and examples. Takes up to 5 GitHub URLs, package ids (npm/pypi), remote MCP URLs or names per call.
name: check_tools
title: Check tools before installing
